Site structure: Home dept at /GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/ groups Home+Tech under one nav item; walked the full Home landing page facet list (Kitchen, Candles & fragrance, Dining, Home accessories, Outdoors, Bedroom, Lighting, Furniture, Books, Stationery, Bathroom, Pet accessories, Household electrical, Laundry & cleaning) plus each department's own facet chips, per the cross-room-scatter rule, since a prior Home-Decor pass on this company excluded Furniture/Bedroom/Outdoors entirely. Furniture-bearing nodes found: (1) the dedicated Furniture department at /furniture/ with 4 sub-facets (Storage furniture, Tables, Chairs, Stools) - note the Home landing page's own nav chip shows a parent rollup of 'Furniture237' while the Furniture page's own rendered header says '219 results'; the 219 (and each sub-facet's own header) was used since Rule 1 prefers the page's own header over a parent nav count, and no leaf row relies on either parent number. (2) Garden furniture (34) filed under the Outdoors department, output under a separate 'Outdoor Furniture' category bucket since the site itself places it outside the Furniture department. Checked and confirmed FURNITURE-FREE: Bedroom (442, all bedding/linens: pillowcases, bedsheets, duvet covers/sets, bedspreads & throws, pillows - no beds/frames), Dining (all tableware: glassware, teacups, plates, bowls, serveware, cutlery, bar accessories, dining sets [dinnerware, not furniture dining sets], placemats, salt & pepper, jugs, teapots, cakestands, napkins, table linen), Bathroom (towels, bathrobes, bath mats, bathroom accessories, bathroom mirrors - no vanity units/bathroom furniture), Home accessories (decorative accessories, vases, cushions, ornaments, photo frames, rugs & mats, blankets & throws, mirrors, candle holders, clocks, wall art - all decor, no furniture), Kitchen (cookware/appliances dept per prior pass, no furniture facet). Tables (41/41), Chairs (23/23) and Stools (14/14) are clean single-purpose furniture facets, verified via full product-title read of each (all items fit on one page each) - no lighting/mirrors/textiles/standalone-storage found; header counts cross-checked against the parent Furniture page's own nav chip counts (Tables41, Chairs23, Stools14 - exact match). Storage furniture (147) and Garden furniture (34) are genuine mixed roll-ups with no facet or filter to split further (only Brand/Colour/Price chips exist on both pages, no product-type sub-facet): Storage furniture mixes real furniture (Kartell Componibili drawer units, HAY/Ferm Living/Kartell cabinets, bar trolleys) with excluded standalone storage goods (HAY stackable crates, Makaua woven baskets, Decor Walther boxes, coat racks/hooks, magazine rack, laundry baskets) and decorative wall shelves - sampled the full first page (60/147 titles): roughly 16 clear furniture items vs ~40 clearly excluded storage/accessory items vs a handful of ambiguous 'rack' items, no clean way to isolate a furniture-only count from the site's own data. Garden furniture mixes real outdoor furniture (Seletti Industry aluminium tables, HAY Xline chair, Seletti aluminium chair, HAY Palissade ottoman, HAY Weekday benches, HAY folding stool, Seletti/Toiletpaper deckchairs) with excluded outdoor lighting (multiple &Tradition Flowerpot and HAY Pao/Apollo portable lamps), excluded standalone storage (Korbo metal storage baskets/bucket) and excluded parasol/umbrella accessories - sampled all 34/34 titles: roughly 15 furniture items vs ~13 excluded (lighting/storage/parasol) vs a few ambiguous. Both flagged null per the mixed-roll-up rule (site reports one blended count with no sub-facet to isolate furniture-only; a manually reclassified count would not be the site's own reported number for any URL). Sanity checks: h1/canonical matched the requested node on every page loaded; no round-number caps seen; counts did not drift between the two reads taken per page.
